config.autoLockMinutes.description: Minutes until automatic lock on inactivity (0 = disabled)
config.mcp.enabled.description: Lets AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) use your connections through a local MCP server: list connections and run read-only kubectl commands (never Secrets). Every changing command needs confirmation in VS Code. Off by default.
config.ai.claudeCommand.description: Command that starts Claude Code in an AI terminal. Empty = "claude --permission-mode default". Shell syntax and flags that disable approvals are refused.
config.ai.codexCommand.description: Command that starts Codex in an AI terminal. Empty = "codex --ask-for-approval untrusted". Shell syntax and flags that disable approvals are refused.
config.statusCheckIntervalSeconds.descri: Interval in seconds for automatic cluster status checks (0 = disabled)
config.customTerminalPrompt.description: Sets a "kubectl@<connection-name> >" prompt in terminals (bash/zsh/PowerShell; cmd without color). Color is configurable per connection.
config.language.description: UI language of the extension. "auto" follows VS Code's display language.
